text:
jp: spinning up the new gpu fleet in ap-east-2 tomorrow, need a quick security sanity checklist for IAM/KMS/secrets before handoff. cc @maria_sec and @alex_infra

maria_sec: +1. We should validate: service account scopes, least-priv role bindings, KMS key policies, secrets encryption at rest, and ensures HSM wrapping for root keys.

alex_infra: can you share the current terraform module and the SA names you plan to use? I want to make sure we don't create wildcard roles.
jp: planned SAs: `redwood-gpu-provisioner`, `redwood-node-reconciler`, `redwood-model-puller`. repo: https://git.internal/rw/infra-gpu-provisioning (priv)

maria_sec: ok. Quick checklist I recommend (short):
- No owner/admin roles on SAs; use narrowly scoped custom roles
- KMS keys: customer-managed, rotation enabled, IAM members restricted to service accounts only
- HSM: enable key protection level = HSM for all root wrapping keys
- Secrets: use KMS envelope encryption + secret manager with IAM condition that only cluster SA can access
- Audit logs: enable data access and admin activity for KMS/Secret Manager
- Network: VPC-SC or private service access for secret retrieval if required

sam_oncall: add: ensure node bootstrapping doesn't log plaintext credentials, and enable metadata concealment on nodes: `gcloud compute instances add-metadata --no-enable-oslogin` (example).

alex_infra: re: terraform, we should have a preflight plan job in CI that runs `terraform plan` and scans for `google_project_iam_binding` with `roles/owner` or `*` patterns. I can add a Danger/terrascan check.

jp: can we also require a manual approval in console before KMS key creation? want to avoid accidental broad grants.

maria_sec: yes — create an approvers list in the runbook. Approval steps: security lead + infra lead. Use a PR template: `--kms-keys: name, purpose, rotation_days, hsm_required` and a required `security/approved` label.

kevin_sre: deploy-bot: new infra plan triggered by jp: `infra/provision/ap-east-2`
deploy-bot: CI job started: terraform plan -> terrascan -> policy checks. Results will post here.

jp: posted the PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra-gpu-provisioning/pulls/42. CI showing one violation: `secret_manager_policy` allows `allAuthenticatedUsers` on access.

maria_sec: remove that binding. Replace with condition restricting to `serviceAccount:redwood-node-reconciler@...` and add log-based metric for accesses.

alex_infra: after fixes, I'll run smoke provisioning in a private subnet with isolated egress. test steps:
1) create VPC + subnets
2) create HSM-backed KMS key
3) create minimal SAs and bind roles
4) provision 1 GPU node pool (no autoscale)
5) verify node can fetch model blob using only its SA token
6) confirm no plaintext secrets on disk

jp: tagging this thread for handoff docs. Once smoke passes, who signs off for handoff to ops?

maria_sec: I will sign security for KMS/Secrets. Alex for infra provisioning. Sam for oncall readiness. After that, we do a 1-week canary with limited customer traffic.

kevin_sre: reminder: cost controls — set `quota/commitment` in cluster config and a billing alert for GPU spend > $X/day. Add a per-cluster cost center tag.

jp: noted. I'll update PR with the `security/approved` label after changes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
